# Quick Reference

> Build a printable quick reference guide for your hazardous waste contingency plan, and train your emergency coordinators on their duties under the RCRA generator rules.

Quick Reference (https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Contingency Plan & Emergency Coordinator, RCRA Generator Training, RCRA Generator Refresher, First Responder Awareness training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Hazardous Waste Contingency Plan and Emergency Coordinator Training](https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 40 CFR Parts 262 and 264/265. The emergency coordinator's duties and the contingency plan. Enroll: https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training?buy=412
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training](https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA). The full generator course. Enroll: https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training?buy=601
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Refresher Training](https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training): $59.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA, annual). The annual refresher for LQG staff. Enroll: https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training?buy=600
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Recognize, isolate, notify. Enroll: https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099

## Guides

- [The emergency coordinator's duties, step by step](https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/guides/emergency-coordinator-duties): What the rules expect the coordinator to do from the first alarm to the follow-up report.
- [Contingency plan checklist for LQGs](https://emergency-coordinator.hazwoperosha.us/guides/contingency-plan-checklist): What the plan must contain, and when to update it.
